title: PostgreSQL internals, Part 4: indexes beyond B-tree
tldr: How PostgreSQL indexes work on disk and when each pays: B-tree pages and ctid pointers, why a non-HOT UPDATE writes every index, index-only scans, column order and PG18 skip scan, partial, expression and covering indexes, GIN, GiST, SP-GiST, BRIN and Hash with their operator classes, building concurrently, write amplification, GIN pending-list stalls, ignored indexes, and an interview drill.
